reason: I have a freelancer I already trust and I'm not moving a nonprofit's money onto a new platform that nobody has audited. I'd also have to explain USDC on Solana to my finance person, and that alone kills it.
objection: I'm accountable for every dollar. A brand-new, unaudited platform where I pay in crypto and only the winner gets paid is hard to justify, and I can't tell my board why I didn't just call my freelancer or use ChatGPT.
would_change_my_mind: Pay by card or invoice instead of USDC, plus a reference from another organisation like mine that has used it, with the free trial task run for me so there is no risk.
